thread:
Mia: heads-up — customer reported regression after we flipped to 4-bit quant for blackbird-9p5b on dedicated. quality drop on their prompt set, answers are hallucinating more. can we triage? :frowning:
Raj: ack. do we have the eval artifact + seed logs? rough delta numbers?
Mia: attaching quick summary below. eval on customer promptset: f1-like metric dropped 0.18 -> 0.12. BLEU/ROUGE both down ~10%. we pushed the q4 recipe yesterday (q4_0_v2) with per-channel scale. logs: "kv_cache_mismatch" seen a few times in runtime.
Kim: infra-bot shows the deploy succeeded but a handful of pods restarted during rollout. rolling restart at 02:13 UTC. I pulled the pod logs, saw this error repeating:
```
E 02:13:27 kernel_select: mismatched-kv-length for request_id=ab12
W 02:13:29 batch_dispatch: fallback to unbatched path
```
Raj: hmm kv cache mismatch + fallback could explain odd generations. was the model converted with the updated KV ordering patch? we changed transpose in convert script last week.
Mia: conversion used convert_v3.py from the onboarding repo. I can re-run with the older transpose flag if needed.
Jon: customer is on Dedicated Standard SLA — they saw a 12% increase in bad responses. they asked for a temporary rollback to the previous float16 variant until we fix. is that safe? can we do a canary rollback?
Kim: we can shift traffic to blackbird-9p5b-fp16 variant in routing policy for that tenant. small config tweak in router: set route override for tenant_id X -> variant fp16. takes ~30s to apply.
Raj: before rollback, can we validate a quick local decode comparison between fp16 and q4_0_v2 on a sample of the failing set? I can run a diff job. give me the list of 200 prompts.
Mia: uploading sample set to S3: s3://redwood-onboard/blackbird/tenantX_regress_sample.csv
QA-bot: smoke-run completed on sample (100 prompts) — results:
- fp16: avg_perplexity 18.2, hallucination_rate 3.1%
- q4_0_v2: avg_perplexity 24.7, hallucination_rate 11.6%
Attached small head-to-head logs at s3://.../smoke-run-2755504321.tar.gz
Raj: thanks. I'll diff logits/kv behavior. initial hunch: conversion produced an off-by-one kv offset for attention masks under bfloat3 optimization path. will instrument.
Kim: rolling rollback plan: if Raj confirms, I'll flip route override and pin variant. post-rollback we'll keep q4 variant in isolated pool to debug. need approval from product for customer impact msg.
Jon: approve — notify customer of temporary rollback and ETA for root cause. I'll draft the note once rollback is confirmed. include mitigation steps and ETA window.
Mia: confirmed, please proceed with rollback if Raj signs off. also want a postmortem checklist: reproducible diff, conversion script params, kernel trace, and any autoscaler restarts.
Raj: signing off to rollback after 10m of tracing (to collect kv traces). will post results in-thread.
infra-bot: deploy event: rollback job queued for tenant X, worker pool reserved, estimated time 00:00:45 to completion.
Raj: trace results: found kv index mismatch when sequence_length % 8 != 0 under our custom attention kernel. patch prepared: fix-kv-index-rotate. testing now on isolated q4 pool.
Kim: applying route override now to point tenant X -> blackbird-9p5b-fp16, rolling across 4 routers. :ok_hand:
Mia: customer notified: "We've rolled back your serving variant to a stable FP16 build while we investigate a quantization edge-case. No data lost. ETA for fix: 48 hrs." :thumbsup:
QA-bot: post-rollback smoke: hallucination_rate on customer sample returned to 2.9% (within baseline). logs: s3://.../post-rollback-smoke-2755506120.json
Jon: thanks team. next steps: merge Raj's patch into convert and runtime, schedule a gated canary with longer seq lengths, and add a unit test for seq%8 edge-case. I'll add to roadmap.
Mia: adding triage notes to the onboarding ticket and closing the immediate incident. great job everyone. :tada:
